parameters: @niko I think it's coming from south-east of here.
@calamus Have you seen a little girl?
@calamus She's a little bit shorter than you, and-
@calamus_sad My little sister... she's been gone for three days now.
@calamus I've been looking all over, but...
@calamus_speak Um...\. a little shorter than you, long blue hair, two blue feathers on top of her head...
@niko I'm sorry, I haven't seen anyone like that...
@niko_speak Where was the last place you saw her?
@calamus She said she was headed towards the forest, so I'm waiting here now.
@calamus_sad I ran out of places to look...
@calamus_speak I don't remember why, but our father left the village while we were still young.
@calamus We've lived in the ruins ever since.
@calamus_sad ...Well, it's just Alula and I now.
@calamus_speak Alula is all I have.\nI can't lose her...
@alula_pout I was trapped inside this room and it was really scary...
@alula_pout There was that weird stuff in the door!
@alula_oh You know, the floating squares we see next to the ocean sometimes?
@alula_oh The stuff you told me to stay away from?
@calamus_shock It's... spread to the ruins now?
@alula_speak Don't worry! I didn't touch it!
@calamus_sad Still... If it gets any worse, we might have to find somewhere else to live...
@niko What is this... square... stuff, exactly?
@calamus Anything that touches them just... sorta...
@calamus_sad Whenever you hear people say the world is decaying, that's what they meant...
@calamus_speak Obviously, you should avoid them too.
@calamus I can't thank you enough for rescuing my sister, savior...
@calamus_shame Oh gosh! Would it not be rude to call you by name?
@niko I mean, I'm just a kid like you guys...
@calamus_smile Then... would you like to visit our house, Niko?
@niko_speak I'm sorry, but I think \p might want to go somewhere else right now!
@calamus_smile That's fine.\.\. I'm sure you both have more important things to do right now.
@calamus_smile But feel free to drop by if you change your mind.
@alula_speak Yeah!\.\. We have something nice to give you, Niko!
@alula We live in the ruins.\| So don't forget!
@calamus_speak Oh, by the way, what happened to the sun?
@niko I lent it to someone in the ruins.\nShe said she wanted to feel the sun again, before.\..\..
@calamus Oh, Maize.\nI've met her before, too.
@calamus There used to be a lot more plant people around here...\nThat's what my father told me.
@niko_eyeclosed I'm glad she got to see the sun again, at least.
